title: 第七章 班吉拉和求助第八章 大木博士的冠军梦
content_zh:
杰尼龟很坚强，在神奇宝贝中心恢复治疗后毅然继续训练。
林萧当然不会让杰尼龟一直挨揍，他想要告诉杰尼龟的是：想要学会打人就的先学会挨打，况且挨打也是有学问的。
能闪避的时候就闪避，闪不开就要学会怎么做才能让自己所受的伤害降到最低，如果一直硬接别人的技能那是愚蠢的，就算体力强大的吉利蛋也挨不住几下，更别说杰尼龟这种算是体力单薄的小家伙了。
至于快龙，林萧没有任何办法，只有等自己手里有了其他实力强大的小精灵再1v1训练，没有压力的训练还不如让它多休息一下来得实在。
杰尼龟当了4天的沙包，不论是闪避、抗打、反应能力都提升不少，期间林萧也带着杰尼龟挑战一些训练家，一直挨打也要让它消消火。
存够一万金币的林萧迫不及待的打开系统，想要购买自己的第一支小精灵，也是自己最喜欢的一只，班吉拉。
“系统，但愿你不要让我失望。”
调出班吉拉的图标，林萧咬牙购买。一只班吉拉要一万金币，而由基拉只要三千，但林萧还是选择购买班吉拉。
不是林萧不想购买由基拉从小培养，而是养不起，林萧出发旅行用的钱都是这几年给大木博士当助理，所得的一点补贴。，尽管林萧抱着能省则省的想法，可也支撑不了多久。
没有钱什么都是空谈，幼小的由基拉需要吃各种能量块补充身体的营养，为以后打牢基础，而能量块的价格高得令人发颤。曾今就有人为了省钱而做出这样的蠢事，结果培育出来的小精灵发育不良，实力低下。那位训练家也从此沦为联盟中的笑柄，最后把小精灵放生归隐了。
联盟发布的各种任务，都需要以实力来算计的，就像林萧在常磐市看重一个捕捉暴鲤龙的任务，任务要求必须要有三只小精灵，其中两只达到终极进化的才能接，快龙的实力有天王级，但林萧也只能鼓着眼睛看。
如果有了班吉拉，加上快龙和杰尼龟，林萧就能接到很多奖金丰厚的任务。
要是有人跳出来指责林萧贪钱，林萧绝对会一口盐汽水喷死他。不管在哪个世界钱都是万能的，有钱人家的训练家通常都出钱购买初始小精灵，你联盟发的别人压根就看不上，出发那天就领取图鉴而已。没钱那么对不起，一切靠自己。林萧就曾看见到大木研究领取图鉴的新人训练家，图鉴拿走了，初始小精灵带的是从小陪伴自己的哈克龙，这样的训练家只要不是一个sb，以后绝对会是天王候选人。
实力强大，联盟给的福利越好，快龙虽然和林萧一起旅行，实力再强大那也是别人的，现在跟着你一起旅行，搞不清哪一天就回到别人的身边了，这也就是林萧急着买班吉拉最重要的原因。
‘购买班吉拉需要一万金币，是否购买？’
“是！！”林萧毫不犹豫选择了是。
‘恭喜宿主第一次购买小精灵，第一次购买带有福利，可获得精灵蛋一枚，请宿主再接再厉。’
“精灵蛋？”林萧看着手中洁白的蛋一愣，“小精灵的但不是都有花纹吗？这颗蛋除了底部有点红色其它都是白色，系统也不提示可以孵出什么小精灵来。还有我买的班吉。。。。。。”
“蹦！！！”
话还没说完，林萧所住的房间一亮，顿时发出一声巨响，房间里的床和柜子四分五裂，楼顶好像被什么给弄出一个大洞，碎石纷飞。

“草！”林萧抱着精灵蛋飞快的逃到外面，目瞪口呆的看着已经变成废墟还在摇晃的房间。旅店中的人吓得惊慌失措，纷纷叫着：“地震啦，大家快点跑！！。”
“班~！班！！！”
废墟中，一只高达5米的班吉拉，不爽的看着顶着自己脑袋的楼板，正用手砸着楼板，想要空间变得大一些，巨大的尾巴左右横少，让房间摇摇欲坠。5米高800公斤重的班吉拉每走一步，整栋房子都会跟着摇动，二楼的几间客房跨了下来。
林萧连死的心情都有了，“这尼玛不是坑爹吗？怎么就把系统购买的班吉拉要比平常的班吉拉大上一号的事情忘记了。”
旅店中的人跑到外面的空地上发现不是地震这才心有余悸的转回来。
“住手，别拆了！！！”林萧心惊肉跳的连忙拿出一个精灵球把班吉拉收回来，才制止了这次拆房事件，不过一切都晚了，两层的旅店已经倒塌了一大半。
旅店老板双手叉着自己水桶般粗壮的腰朝着林萧怒吼，“你是白痴吗？怎么能在酒店中把体型巨大的小精灵放出来，不仅把客人吓成这样还把握的房子给破坏了，你要让我怎么做生意！！！”
“对不起，我会赔偿的，这都是我的失误。”
林萧不断的给旅店老板赔礼道歉，才打消了老板报警的想法，不过扣押了他的图鉴，要求尽快做出赔偿，否则就会请君沙来通过法律途径解决。
“真他娘的倒霉起来喝口水都塞牙，只有找大木博士求助了。”林萧无奈的拨通了大木研究所的电话。
“你好，我是大木博士。”
“博士，是我。”看着一脸微笑的大木博士，林萧欲言又止，不知该怎么说。
看着欲言又止的林萧，大木博士怒火攀升，额头上鼓起几个井字符号破口大骂：“你这混蛋，我不是告诉过你每到一个城市都要打电话来吗？这么久没有消息，老头子我还以为你失踪了呢！！！”
“当初让你转到我们大木家的户籍下，你不愿意。老子我一直把你当做我的亲孙子一样，可你混蛋就是不领情，你是不是要把我气死你才甘心？”
面对大木博士的怒骂，林萧眼眶湿润，心里哽咽，他自己知道大木博士对自己的心意。毫不客气的说，大木博士对待林萧比对他自己的亲孙子小茂还好，完全就像自家人一样，就算是转户籍也只是办理一些领养证明，林萧并不需要改姓大木。
也正是因为这样林萧拒绝了大木博士的好心，一旦林萧接受了大木博士的好意，按照大木博士对他的态度绝对会造成小茂和大木博士之间产生间隔，导致爷孙俩关系闹僵、疏远。
大骂一阵的大木博士这才顺了几口气问道：“说吧，出了什么事，如果不是你自己处理不了的事情我想你也不会给我打电话。”
抬手擦了擦微红的眼眶，林萧把事情的经过一一说出。
“我知道了，我会马上赶过来。这次我会把你的户籍转到我大木家的名下，不管你愿不愿意，听到了没有？”大木博士说完狠狠的瞪了林萧一眼，挂断了电话，能让老好人大木博士发这么大的火，林萧算是联盟第一号了。。。。。

content_en:
Squirtle is strong and continues training after recovering from treatment at the Pokémon Center.
Of course, Lin Xiao will not let Squirtle be beaten all the time. What he wants to tell Squirtle is: if you want to learn to beat people, you must first learn to be beaten, and being beaten is also learned.
If you can dodge, dodge. If you can't dodge, you have to learn how to do it to minimize the damage you take. It would be stupid to keep taking other people's skills. Even the strong Geely Egg can't withstand a few hits, let alone a little guy like Squirtle who is weak in physical strength.
As for Kuailong, Lin Xiao had no choice but to wait until he had other powerful elves before training him 1v1. Training without pressure would be more practical than letting him rest more.
Squirtle served as a punching bag for four days, and his dodge, resistance, and reaction abilities improved a lot. During this period, Lin Xiao also took Squirtle to challenge some trainers, and he had to calm down after being beaten all the time.
Lin Xiao, who had saved 10,000 gold coins, couldn't wait to open the system and wanted to buy his first elf and his favorite one, Bangira.
"System, I hope you won't disappoint me."
Pulling up the icon of Banjila, Lin Xiao gritted his teeth and bought it. A bandila costs 10,000 gold coins, while a Yukila only costs 3,000 gold coins, but Lin Xiao still chooses to buy a bandila.
It's not that Lin Xiao doesn't want to buy Yu Kira, who has been training him since he was a child, but he can't afford it. The money Lin Xiao spent on the trip was a little subsidy from being an assistant to Dr. Omu in the past few years. , even though Lin Xiao had the idea of ​​​​saving money if he could, he couldn't sustain it for long.
Without money, everything is empty talk. Young Yukira needs to eat various energy blocks to replenish his body's nutrition and lay a solid foundation for the future, and the price of energy blocks is shockingly high. There have been people who have done stupid things like this in order to save money. As a result, the elves they cultivated were stunted and had low strength. The trainer also became a laughing stock in the alliance, and finally released the elf and went into seclusion.
Various tasks issued by the alliance need to be calculated based on strength. For example, Lin Xiao valued a task of capturing Gyarados in Viridian City. The task required three elves, two of which had reached the ultimate evolution to be accepted. The strength of Kuailong was at the king level, but Lin Xiao could only watch with wide eyes.
With Bangira, Kuailong and Squirtle, Lin Xiao will be able to receive many missions with generous bonuses.
If someone jumped out and accused Lin Xiao of being greedy for money, Lin Xiao would definitely spray him to death with a mouthful of salt soda. No matter in which world money is omnipotent, trainers from wealthy families usually pay to buy the initial Pokémon. Others in your alliance will not look at it at all, and they will just receive the illustrated guide on the day of departure. I'm sorry if I don't have money, I have to do everything on my own. Lin Xiao once saw a new trainer who went to Damu Research to get a illustrated book. The illustrated book was taken away. The initial elf brought the Hackron who had been with him since he was a child. As long as such a trainer is not a bastard, he will definitely be a candidate for the king in the future.
The stronger the strength, the better the benefits the alliance provides. Although Kuailong is traveling with Lin Xiao, no matter how strong it is, it belongs to someone else. Now that I am traveling with you, I don't know when I will return to someone else. This is the most important reason why Lin Xiao is eager to buy Bangila.
‘It takes 10,000 gold coins to buy Banjila. Do you want to buy it? ’
"Yes!!" Lin Xiao chose yes without hesitation.
‘Congratulations to the host for purchasing an elf for the first time. The first purchase comes with benefits and you can get an elf egg. Please keep up the good work. ’
"Elf egg?" Lin Xiao looked at the white egg in his hand and was stunned, "Don't all the elves have patterns? Except for the red bottom, the rest of this egg is white, and the system does not prompt what kind of elves can be hatched. And the Benji I bought..."
"Bounce!!!"
Before he finished speaking, the room where Lin Xiao lived lit up, and there was a loud noise. The bed and cabinet in the roomThe house was torn apart, and something seemed to have made a big hole in the roof, with rubble flying everywhere.
"Fuck!" Lin Xiao quickly ran outside with the elf egg in his arms, staring dumbfounded at the room that had turned into ruins and was still shaking. People in the hotel were frightened and panicked, shouting: "It's an earthquake, everyone, run quickly!!"
"Ban~! Ban!!!"
In the ruins, a 5-meter-tall Banjira looked unhappily at the floor that was holding its head. It was hitting the floor with its hands, trying to make the space larger. Its huge tail stretched sideways, making the room shaky. Every time the 5-meter-tall and 800-kilogram Banjira takes a step, the entire house shakes, and several guest rooms on the second floor step down.
Lin Xiao even felt like dying, "Isn't this a lie? Why did you forget that the Bangila purchased by the system is one size larger than the normal Bangila?"
The people in the hotel ran to the open space outside and came back with lingering fears when they realized it was not an earthquake.
"Stop, don't demolish it!!!" Lin Xiao was so frightened that he quickly took out a Poké Ball and pulled Banjira back, thus stopping the demolition incident. However, it was too late. More than half of the two-story hotel had collapsed.
The hotel owner put his hands on his waist as thick as a bucket and roared at Lin Xiao, "Are you an idiot? How could you release a huge elf in the hotel? Not only did you scare the guests like this, but you also destroyed the house. How do you want me to do business!!!"
"I'm sorry, I will compensate. This is all my mistake."
Lin Xiao kept apologizing to the hotel owner before he gave up the idea of calling the police. However, he seized his illustrated book and demanded compensation as soon as possible, otherwise Junsha would be asked to resolve it through legal means.
"I'm so damn unlucky that my teeth are stuck even when I drink water. I have no choice but to ask Dr. Omu for help." Lin Xiao reluctantly dialed the number of Omu Research Institute.
"Hello, I am Dr. Oak."
"Doctor, it's me." Looking at Dr. Omu with a smile on his face, Lin Xiao hesitated, not knowing what to say.
Seeing Lin Xiao who was hesitant to speak, Dr. Ohmu's anger rose. Several tic-tac-toe symbols bulged on his forehead and he cursed: "You bastard, didn't I tell you to call every city you go to? There has been no news for so long, old man, I thought you were missing!!!"
"When I asked you to transfer to the household registration of our Damu family, you were unwilling. I have always regarded you as my own grandson, but you bastard just don't appreciate it. Do you want to make me angry to death before you are willing to do it?"
Facing Dr. Omu's scolding, Lin Xiao's eyes were wet and his heart was choked. He knew what Dr. Omu felt about him. To put it bluntly, Dr. Damu treated Lin Xiao better than his own grandson Xiaomao, just like his own family. Even if he changed his household registration, he only needed to apply for some adoption certificates. Lin Xiao did not need to change his surname to Damu.
It is precisely because of this that Lin Xiao rejected Dr. Omu's kindness. Once Lin Xiao accepted Dr. Omu's kindness, Dr. Omu's attitude towards him would definitely create a gap between Xiao Mao and Dr. Omu, leading to a tense and estranged relationship between the grandfather and grandson.
Dr. Omu, who had been cursing for a while, then took a few breaths and asked, "Tell me, what happened? If it wasn't something you couldn't handle yourself, I don't think you would have called me."
Raising his hand to wipe his reddish eyes, Lin Xiao told what happened one by one.
"I know, I will rush over right away. This time I will transfer your household registration to the name of my Damu family, whether you want it or not, did you hear me?" After Dr. Damu said this, he glared at Lin Xiao fiercely and hung up the phone. To make the good old Dr. Damu so angry, Lin Xiao is considered the number one in the alliance. . . . .
